race.comment: LION HUNT (2) resumes. Well supported on debut ($4.80/$3.80), with a fast finishing third over 1300m at Kembla Grange on a heavy (8) surface. Primed with the two good trials and Zac Lloyd takes the reins from the low draw. Hard to stop. HUNGRY (1) three-year-old The Autumn Sun gelding out of AJC Oaks winner Once Were Wild on debut for the Sara Ryan stable. Didn't show a lot in her two trials and look for a better performance under race conditions. BANNER BANNER (5) seven weeks between runs when he caught the eye late to secure fifth over 1100m at this track. Fitter now and worth another chance out to the 1300m. BASCILICA BABE (6) hard fit for this and like the way she held on after going out quickly when fifth over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Don't dismiss.
